findings.finding: Source01 receives prior result/seal references but does not traverse all prior refresh payloads for enable, or prior refresh/enable payloads and actual enable authority for capture, before the controller starts. The controller itself reads those originals. Source01 must not be represented as complete later-phase pre-entry coverage.

findings.resolution: Separate immutable source02 statically checked in full. Exact delta: two source/receipt placement changes and six lines checking refresh16, enable18 and actual enable-authority input. All three real diff hunks and full original/new native source outputs match. Source01 and original refresh evidence remain unchanged.
findings.remaining_gate: Source-only resolution; later original current-key checks, exact product/native closure and root phase grants remain required. This audit executes neither entry source.

findings.finding: The final-result expression alone checks exit_code presence and absence of session_id, not typed exit, exact product request/session continuity or raw streams. Null or string exit_code can satisfy that expression syntactically. The helper is not an original-native receiver.
findings.disposition: No current defect in the audited layered refresh: original request, exact argv/ENV4/cwd/redirections, product session71439 and integer exit0 completion, complete controller/comparator streams and native closed receipt are independently checked. Future phases require the same original reception; endpoint PASS alone is insufficient.

findings.finding: Entry validation is partial, not a closed-world grant-schema checker. The controller enforces exact decision/schema/fixed receipt roles/build ENV/cwd and runtime argv before its child launches.
findings.disposition: Audited refresh grant has been compared field-for-field with the exact expected authority. Root/source/current-key/successor grant roles stay separate.

findings.finding: After-capture deliberately drops cold-output absence so endpoint closure can follow a settled failure; it does not prove a successful cold build. Rich metadata, source/runtime maps and owned-session closure are bounded endpoints, not continuous OS or escaped-writer tracing.
findings.disposition: Retained limitation, no new build or page acceptance.
